title: linaria striata var. monspessulana
intro: Linaria striata var. monspessulana, commonly known as Sticky Toadflax or Purple Toadflax, is a flowering plant in the figwort family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the excretion of mucus and other fluids, making it a useful treatment for colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of Linaria striata var. monspessulana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
